create.name: Embodied Philosophy
create.bio:
Embodied Philosophy is an online school of yoga philosophy, meditation and contemplative study, founded in 2015 by Jacob Kyle, a doctoral researcher at Oxford working on the Kashmiri philosophers Utpaladeva and Abhinavagupta. It is rooted in Kashmir's non-dual Tantric lineage, with particular weight on the Pratyabhijñā or 'recognition' school and on the aesthetics of rasa, but its teaching reaches out to the Yoga Sūtras, Buddhist thought, Christian mysticism and the Hellenic traditions. Every programme pairs close reading of texts with practice such as guided meditation, mantra and reflection.

Students can join free monthly Living Room Lectures, a Monday meditation pass, the Wisdom School membership of weekly sits, monthly lectures and learning pathways, or Sādhana School, its flagship twelve-month programme of seasonal terms with a summer immersion. Faculty include Mary Reilly Nichols, Oneika Mays, Nataraj Chaitanya, Edwin Bryant, Andrew Holecek and James Bae. The school also publishes the journal Tarka and a podcast, and its YouTube channel, active since 2015, carries long conversations and lectures on Tantra, kuṇḍalinī, karma, the subtle body and devotional poetry.

courses.title: Wisdom School membership
courses.description: A yearly membership with a live guided meditation each week, a monthly lecture and seasonal workshops, built around one theme a year. The Plus level adds the full library of learning pathways and continuing-education certificates for yoga teachers.

courses.title: Sādhana School 2026–27 (full year)
courses.description: The school's twelve-month flagship programme of text study and daily practice in the Kashmiri non-dual lineage, taught in seasonal terms with a closing summer intensive and a regular cohort. Single seasons can also be taken, the next being Winter 2027 on Utpaladeva's devotional poems ($497).

courses.title: Meditation Pass (Meditation Mondays)
courses.description: A live guided meditation on Zoom every Monday with the school's faculty, drawing on yoga, Tantra and other contemplative traditions. Sessions are recorded, and single drop-ins can be bought.

free_resources.title: Living Room Lectures
free_resources.description: A free monthly live lecture on Zoom about where the contemplative traditions meet everyday life, with replays for those who sign up. The series returns in January 2027.
